decision: Source-clear for one exact combined finite invocation
findings: Replacement version is validated before file reading, then serialized as one canonical plain first field followed by one file. Original attach wire format is preserved.
fileBytes references the exact copied file slice of the outgoing body; bounded name/MIME/magic/size/boundary checks are retained.
Wire seam loads only the actual serializer and transport, replacing signer, codec primitives and fetch with explicit finite VM fakes. It requires the experimental VM flag.
Media tests import only the two dependency-free actual helpers and built-ins; new cases check signed version bytes and invalid versions plus same-file new-hash lease release/late Blob disposal.
limits: No real signature verification, network, browser, image decoder, database or publication qualification.
Adapter uncertainty corrections remain under separate review; this command does not import upload-client.ts.
